_comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT. Verus telemetry (Component 2). TEAM DEFAULT: point Claude Code at the dev hot-reload HTTP server. The team runs verus-tools-mcp under `cargo watch` (in the verus-tools-mcp repo: `scripts/dev-http.sh`, endpoint http://127.0.0.1:8765/mcp) so edits hot-reload without restarting Claude. The SessionStart gate hook (.claude/hooks/verus_gate.py) probes this endpoint and blocks if it is unreachable. Non-dev colleagues / the box / CI should use the pinned stdio launcher in .mcp.prod.json instead (see .claude/hooks/README.md).
